facts.text: MCPHS students can cross-register for course offerings across member institutions in the Colleges of the Fenway consortium.

sources.title: Colleges of the Fenway (COF) Campus Life | MCPHS
sources.quote: MCPHS students can cross register for course offerings at all of the universities within the Colleges of the Fenway. By cross-registering, a world of opportunity is available to you.
